d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has offered to host inclusive talks in a bid to end the devastating war in Sudan and push toward a national unity government, declaring it is no longer acceptable to stand by with folded arms as the tragedy deepens. Yet Sudan's army-aligned government under Gen. Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has rejected Ethiopia as a mediator—accusing Addis Ababa of backing the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and launching cross-border drones—while RSF-linked figures welcome the initiative. Amid mutual accusations, retaliatory consulate…
